step-1.text: Lay the top upside down on a rug or the flattened box, so the good side stays scratch-free.

step-2.text: Twist a double-ended screw into each corner hole by hand, halfway in. The other half is for the leg.

step-3.text: Twist on the first two legs, clockwise, until they are snug and straight. Hand tight is right.

step-4.text: Same with the last two legs.

step-5.text: Slide the lower shelf between the legs and screw it in, two screws through each leg. Keep the shelf level as you go.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 shelf and 8 screws.

step-6.text: Turn it right side up. Lift it, don't drag it on two legs.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your LACK tv bench is built. Give it a proud little pat.
